subjects.name: Computer Organization
subjects.description: Digital data representation, CPU architecture, memory hierarchy, I/O organization, and pipelining fundamentals.

topics.title: Unit 1 — Introduction & Physical Data Handling
topics.summary: Functional units of a computer, number systems, Boolean algebra, logic gates, and combinational circuits.

topics.title: Unit 2 — The Central Processing Unit
topics.summary: Registers, the instruction cycle, instruction set architecture, addressing modes, and control unit design.

topics.title: Unit 3 — Memory Organization
topics.summary: Memory hierarchy, RAM/ROM, cache mapping techniques, and secondary storage.

topics.title: Unit 4 — Input/Output Organization
topics.summary: I/O devices, programmed I/O, interrupt-driven I/O, and Direct Memory Access (DMA).

topics.title: Unit 5 — Assembly Language & Advanced Concepts
topics.summary: Assembly language basics, instruction pipelining, and a system-level course review.

subjects.name: Advanced Data Structures & Algorithms
subjects.description: Advanced tree/graph structures, algorithm design paradigms, and complexity analysis.

topics.title: Unit 1 — Algorithm Analysis & Complexity
topics.summary: Asymptotic notations, recurrence relations, and complexity classes.

topics.title: Unit 2 — Advanced Trees
topics.summary: AVL trees, Red-Black trees, B-Trees, and B+ Trees.

topics.title: Unit 3 — Graph Algorithms
topics.summary: Graph traversal, shortest path algorithms, and minimum spanning trees.

topics.title: Unit 4 — Design Paradigms
topics.summary: Greedy, divide-and-conquer, and dynamic programming approaches.

topics.title: Unit 5 — NP-Completeness & Advanced Topics
topics.summary: P vs NP, NP-hard/NP-complete problems, and approximation algorithms.

subjects.name: Design & Analysis of Algorithms
subjects.description: Algorithm design techniques, complexity analysis, and problem-solving strategies.

topics.title: Unit 1 — Introduction to Algorithm Analysis
topics.summary: Growth of functions, recurrences, and basic analysis techniques.

topics.title: Unit 2 — Divide and Conquer
topics.summary: Merge sort, quick sort, and binary search variants.

topics.title: Unit 3 — Greedy Method & Dynamic Programming
topics.summary: Knapsack problem, activity selection, and optimal substructure.

topics.title: Unit 4 — Backtracking & Branch and Bound
topics.summary: N-Queens, graph coloring, and traveling salesman approaches.
